meta.name: github-triage
meta.description: Read-only GitHub triage for issues AND PRs. 1 item = 1 background task (category: quick). Analyzes all open items and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim requires a GitHub permalink as proof. NEVER takes any action on GitHub - no comments, no merges, no closes, no labels. Reports only. Triggers: 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', 'github triage'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析 GitHub 仓库的所有议题和 PR，生成带证据的审阅报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解仓库中所有待办事项的现状和优先级
copy.tagline_en: Analyze all open issues and PRs on GitHub, generating evidence-backed triage reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick overview of all open items in a GitHub repository with evidence

howto.what: 它以只读方式逐条分析仓库中所有未关闭的 issue 和 PR,给每条作分类并写出带 GitHub 永久链接作为证据的报告,保存到 /tmp 目录;全程不会在 GitHub 上评论、关闭、合并或打标签。
howto.when: 当话里带有“triage”“triage issues”“github triage”等关键词,要求分析仓库里的 issue 或 PR 时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个仓库的 issue 都 triage 一遍。
say.note: 它会逐条分析所有打开的 issue 并生成带证据的报告。

say.text: triage 一下当前的 pull requests,重点看有没有已修复的问题。
say.note: 报告会标出每条 PR 的类型、审查结论与风险。

say.text: 只读分析,不要评论、不要关闭任何 issue。
say.note: 报告写好后不动 GitHub 上的任何内容。

howto.what_en: It analyzes every open issue and pull request in read-only mode, classifies each one, and writes evidence-backed reports (with GitHub permalinks) to /tmp. It never comments, closes, merges, or labels anything on GitHub.
howto.when_en: It triggers on commands containing keywords like 'triage', 'triage issues', 'github triage'. Runs when the user asks for a read-only analysis of the repo's open issues or PRs.

say_en.text: Please triage all the open issues in this repository.
say_en.note: It writes per-issue reports with permalinks to /tmp.

say_en.text: Triage the open pull requests and flag any that look already fixed.
say_en.note: Reports will note PR type, review status, and risks.

say_en.text: Analyze only — do not comment on or close any issue.
say_en.note: Nothing on GitHub is modified; reports go to /tmp.
